violations.text: The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Items that are undercooked must be noted next to the item. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

Desserts packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Discussed proper labels with PIC. Guidance document provided. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
Knife was observed stored between prep unit and prep table. Knife removed, proper utensil storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The soap dispenser in the kitchen was observed in poor repair. Soap dispenser to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the bleach (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The coving in the kitchen was observed falling off the walls. Coving to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of underneath the reach-in unit have an accumulation of old rodent droppings. Area to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2025

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. Air gap poster provided. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2025
The floor and wall junctures in various areas do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2025
The coving in the back prep area near exit door is in poor repair (Visible gap.) The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/10/2025
